verdict.reason: The pages say api.blotato.com is not a valid base URL and give the two valid URLs, and they say not to trust an agent's claim of an outage.

steps.text: api.blotato.com is not a valid base URL, so if your AI tool reports a DNS error for it, the tool guessed wrong.
Use https://backend.blotato.com/v2 for the REST API, or https://mcp.blotato.com/mcp for the MCP Server.
If an AI agent tells you Blotato is returning a persistent API error, do not trust that summary, and open the Logs and read the raw response.
